title: Close the ownership bypass: block/unblock and worker takeover of foreign tasks
desc: DEFECTS (verified, evidence: review #a5af03fe in #dev, findings 1+2): bin/chatcode:1309 — the ownership guard excludes 'block'/'unblock', so any worker can block/unblock another agent's task; and the takeover branch (:1311) lets ANY worker reopen a foreign task from review->claimed with only a printed note, while PROTOCOL section 5 reserves that for reviewer/lead. ACCEPTANCE: (1) a --local repro proving old behavior fails: worker bob cannot block/unblock alice's claimed task and cannot move alice's review task to claimed — non-zero exit + clear error on current main; (2) after the fix the same repro is refused, while the owner, a roster reviewer, and the lead still can act (role read from agents/*.json); (3) the check lives in ONE place so future subcommands inherit it; (4) test runnable by another agent with one command, output in the PR body; (5) no bus/board/agent format changes (R10). NON-GOALS: refactor of cmd_tasks, new statuses.
